finding_summary: Stag2, Nipbl, and Smc1a formed a data-driven cohesin/cohesin-loader neighborhood around Kmt2d.

finding_summary: The 151 TH signature rewired neuronal adhesion, axon, and synaptic genes in both directions rather than simply down-regulating enhancer targets.

finding_summary: Kmt2d loss in 151 TH dampened CaMK/PKC/potassium-channel and immediate-early activity nodes while up-regulating Hcn3 and a few receptor genes.
finding_consequence: The same thalamic cells that reconfigured adhesion also shifted excitability and activity-coupled transcription, a plausible bridge to the cognitive phenotypes seen in Kmt2d chromatin models.

finding_consequence: These up genes are a compact, experimentally measured candidate marker set for the stressed or compensatory state of Kmt2d-deficient 151 TH neurons.

finding_summary: 151 TH Kmt2d loss altered membrane lipid, inositol-phosphate, and extracellular signaling genes, with cholesterol/inositol nodes and Notum/Gdf11/Bmp6/Ltbp4 mostly down.
finding_consequence: This secondary program is distinct from the synaptic-adhesion axis and suggests compensatory remodeling of membrane composition and extracellular cues in the same responding thalamic neurons.

finding_summary: Gabrb1 was not significantly altered by Nrf1 loss across the informative Nrf1-responsive neuronal groups despite its prior nomination as a neuronal NRF1 target.

These findings align with the observed synaptic, channel, receptor, and calcium-associated cerebellar program without requiring exact marker overlap. ANE1 references support the distinction between this basal neuronal response and infection-triggered inflammation.

finding_summary: The Smarcb1 399-feature signature nominated Smarcc2, Smarce1, Arid1a and Arid2 as positive neighbors, and follow-up in 151 confirmed same-direction overlap for every shared FDR gene tested among those four perturbations.

finding_summary: In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Ap2m1 depressed a large synaptic and calcium/PKC/Ras-Rap transcriptional module.

literature_rationale: The large signed synaptic and signaling program is coherent and well powered. Neuronal AP-2 loss supports impaired synaptic maintenance, but the calcium/PKC/Ras-Rap transcriptional branch remains mechanistically incomplete; thalamic placement is descriptive.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Ap2m1 loss produced a compact sterol-biosynthesis transcriptional decrease in 155 MB Glut, marked by concordant reduction of Srebf2 and Dhcr24.
finding_consequence: A two-gene sterol/cholesterol-biosynthetic decrease in midbrain glutamatergic neurons separates this responder from the thalamic synaptic program and warns against collapsing all AP2M1-responsive neurons into one annotation.
literature_rationale: The AP2M1 and sterol annotations remain separate facts. Even with same-complex reproduction by Ap2s1 in the dataset, the literature ledger contains no target-to-sterol-program bridge.
cell_types: 155 MB Glut

finding_summary: Ap2s1 was by far the strongest positive signature neighbor of Ap2m1 and reproduced the thalamic signature in the same direction.
finding_consequence: The direct AP-2 same-complex comparison anchors the Ap2m1 phenotype to AP-2 biology rather than to an off-target or unrelated thalamic artifact.
literature_rationale: Ap2s1 has a highly informative response and reproduces the Ap2m1 program with extensive exact same-direction overlap. Their mutually stabilizing membership in the obligate AP-2 complex supplies a complete mechanistic chain for coarse convergence.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut

finding_summary: The top anti-correlated neighbors were not robust FDR-level opposites, while Xpo1, Grin1 and Rab7 showed only partial thalamic convergence.
finding_consequence: This keeps the data-driven neighbor calculation from becoming a misleading story: Nrg2, Pi4ka, Kcnq2 and Grin2b ranked highly by restricted cosine but were rejected after exact overlap testing.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Ap2m1 loss produced a narrow neuronal transcriptional response: 4 of 21 measured cell groups had any downstream FDR<0.10 gene, and 198 of the 208 significant loci resided in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut.
finding_consequence: AP-2 is a core endocytic adaptor, so a pan-neuronal stress response would have been plausible. The screen instead localizes the robust RNA response to a thalamic glutamatergic state, with only one-gene or eight-gene spillover elsewhere.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut; 145 MH-LH TH Glut; 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut

finding_summary: The thalamic Ap2m1 signature coupled Tfrc and Gss induction to mixed metabolic rewiring, including lower Slc25a37 and Pfkp.
finding_consequence: Gss up and Tfrc up nominate iron/redox compensation as a secondary branch of the thalamic AP-2 response, distinct from the larger synaptic downshift.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: AP-1/AP-3/AP-4 subunits and synaptic-vesicle endocytic factors did not phenocopy Ap2m1, even though Ap2s1 did.
finding_consequence: The pattern separates the AP2M1/AP2S1 module from generic clathrin-associated vesicle traffic: Ap1b1, Ap1s2, Ap3b2, Ap4s1, Dnm1, Dnajc6 and Synj1 were flat on the Ap2m1 signature in matched responder groups.
cell_types: 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut; 145 MH-LH TH Glut; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut

finding_summary: Despite clear downstream responses, Prdm10 perturbation did not reproduce the ESC-associated Eif3b transcript response in measured neuronal groups.
finding_consequence: A central embryonic PRDM10 effector should not be assumed to explain neuronal Prdm10 phenotypes; the brain response instead centered on Cadm3/Madd/Ptov1-like genes.
literature_rationale: The literature directly supplies a target-to-transcript directional relationship. Developmental and cell-context differences reduce transportability but do not make the bridge incomplete, so the neuronal absence is a specific disagreement.

finding_summary: Prdm10 loss decreased Flcn in midbrain glutamatergic and Pvalb neurons, but Flcn repression was not a broad feature of the larger neuronal Prdm10 response.
finding_consequence: Human Birt-Hogg-Dubé-like PRDM10 disease can operate through FLCN, but most neuronal Prdm10 responses in this atlas did not broadly repress Flcn, implying strong cell-context restriction.
literature_rationale: The observed Flcn decrease in midbrain glutamatergic and Pvalb neurons matches the directly documented PRDM10-to-FLCN regulatory direction. Its restriction to selected neuronal populations refines transportability without weakening the alignment where detected.
cell_types: 052 Pvalb Gaba; 155 MB Glut

finding_summary: The main Prdm10 module was a recurrent negative neuronal adhesion, guidance, synaptic, and excitability program centered on Madd, Cadm3, Ptov1, Myt1, Uchl1, Stmn2, and Kcnt1.
finding_consequence: This is the dataset-nominated P16 neuronal output of Prdm10 loss, distinct from the Eif3b-centered translation program expected from embryonic stem cells.
literature_rationale: The recurrent signed neuronal adhesion, guidance, synaptic, and excitability module is a coherent atlas program across the reported groups. Existing PRDM10 work supports transcriptional activation but provides no specific bridge to this neuronal output.

finding_summary: Prdm10 produced a subcortical-skewed postnatal response, with 204 downstream FDR<0.10 calls in 11 of 23 measured groups and the broadest signatures in thalamic, midbrain, and hypothalamic neurons.
finding_consequence: The effect is real but not pan-neuronal; it localizes an essential early-development transcription factor to a smaller set of P16-sensitive postmitotic neuronal states.

finding_summary: Prdm10 loss decreased Flcn in Pvalb and midbrain glutamatergic neurons and decreased Mlst8 in three subcortical responders, but Mtor, Rptor, Tsc1, and Tsc2 perturbations did not phenocopy the 204-feature Prdm10 signature.
finding_consequence: The human PRDM10-FLCN disease axis is transcriptionally visible in neurons, yet the neuronal response is not equivalent to generic mTOR-pathway loss.
cell_types: 052 Pvalb Gaba; 155 MB Glut; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 191 MB P MY GABA

finding_summary: Autophagy/mitophagy and nuclear-maintenance genes rose in selected strong responders despite the mostly negative Prdm10 signature: Wdr45 and Pink1 rose in thalamic/midbrain groups, Rnaseh2a rose in hypothalamic and hindbrain GABA groups, and Cenpn/Cenpp rose in thalamic or midbrain groups.
finding_consequence: The positive tail is not random sign noise: it nominates a compensatory branch that the snRNA-seq readout could detect after this postmitotic LoF.
cell_types: 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut; 191 MB P MY GABA

finding_summary: Screened PRDM-family relatives Prdm2, Prdm5, Prdm12, and Prdm16 did not share the Prdm10 signature.
finding_consequence: This prevents over-generalizing from PR-domain family membership and shows that the acute neuronal response is specific to Prdm10 rather than a generic PRDM-family LoF state.

finding_summary: The top restricted-signature neighbors of Prdm10 were Tnpo3, Ddx23, Supt16, and Psmb4, while Chrna3, Isl1, Il6st, and Kansl1 were the most negative.
finding_consequence: The data-driven neighborhood points to a nuclear import/splicing/proteasome/chromatin signature space rather than to textbook PRDM paralogs, generating hypotheses for secondary vulnerabilities or buffering programs.

finding_summary: Elp2 is a sharply cell-type-selective responder: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut carried 201 downstream FDR<0.10 genes, whereas 17 measured groups were transcriptomically null and three groups had only one downstream hit each.
finding_consequence: The screen does not show a ubiquitous consequence of Elongator impairment; it isolates a thalamic Prkcd/Grin2c glutamatergic state as the only postnatal neuronal population that crossed a multi-gene stress threshold after Elp2 loss.
literature_rationale: This is a defensible selectivity result rather than a bundled program claim: 151 alone had a multigene response, while adequately sampled and independently response-capable groups lacked one. The distribution remains unsupported by target-specific literature but is informative in the atlas.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: The 151 response is dominated by an ATF4-like amino-acid integrated stress response that up-regulated Asns, Chac1, Ddit3, Atf4, Herpud1, Sesn2 and amino-acid transporters.
finding_consequence: Elongator modifies wobble U34 in tRNAs, so a postmitotic Elp2 defect converging on amino-acid starvation/translation-stress genes is the expected compensatory transcriptional logic rather than a generic damage signature.
literature_rationale: The coordinated ATF4-like amino-acid stress response is strongly observed and follows the complete ELP2/U34-translation/proteostasis-to-ISR chain. Its placement in 151 is observational metadata and does not weaken program agreement.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Elp2 perturbation in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut also induced tRNA-charging and one-carbon/redox support genes, including Cars, Lars, Mars1, Eprs, Shmt2, Mthfd2, Psph, Aldh18a1, Aldh1l2, Cyb5r1, Hspa9 and Lonp1.
finding_consequence: This expands the response beyond a few stress reporters: the perturbed neurons transcriptionally rebuilt aminoacylation capacity, serine/mitochondrial one-carbon metabolism, proline synthesis and organellar quality-control machinery.
literature_rationale: Multiple aminoacylation, one-carbon, redox, and organellar quality-control genes form a coherent secondary ISR module predicted by the supplied mechanistic chain. The 151 distribution is context, not a required literature edge.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: The same 151 Elp2 signature uncoupled ATF4/Herpud1 stress from a broad ATF6/XBP1-like ER-chaperone program: Hspa5, Hsp90b1, Sdf2l1, Pdia6 and Xbp1 were not significant after Elp2 even though Atp2a2 and Gfpt1 induced them in the matched cell group.
finding_consequence: This keeps the result from being overcalled as generic ER UPR; Elp2 loss generated a selective amino-acid/proteostasis branch.
literature_rationale: The strong Elp2 response and active Atp2a2/Gfpt1 controls make sparing of the broad ER-chaperone surface informative. Literature supports possible UPR uncoupling but does not complete the specific mammalian ATF4/Herpud1-versus-ATF6/XBP1 branch prediction.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Elp1, the only other Elongator-family target recovered in the screen, was the strongest positive signature neighbor of Elp2 and co-induced the 151 amino-acid/ISR module.
finding_consequence: This same-complex convergence makes the 151 Elp2 program much more credible than a lone-guide idiosyncrasy: 165 of 201 Elp2 downstream genes were also significant in the same direction after Elp1 perturbation.
literature_rationale: Elp1 is an active comparator with extensive same-direction overlap, and shared Elongator-core function completes the qualitative prediction of program convergence. Exact overlap and neighbor rank are experiment-specific.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Elp1 did not simply phenocopy Elp2 everywhere: it produced additional ISR-like responses in 145 MH-LH TH Glut, 155 MB Glut and 191 MB P MY GABA where Elp2 had one, one and zero downstream genes.
finding_consequence: Same-complex members were not interchangeable in this postnatal mosaic assay; the result argues for an Elp2-specific threshold or buffering rather than a lineage-invariant Elongator phenotype.
literature_rationale: Elp1 is active in each cited group and the groups can support other responses, so the differential response surface is informative. Shared complex membership does not predict Elp1's broader distribution or establish an Elp2-specific buffering mechanism; 052 is excluded because it is not part of the stated differential result.
cell_types: 145 MH-LH TH Glut; 155 MB Glut

finding_summary: The strongest non-Elongator positive neighbors of Elp2 were proteostasis and organelle-stress perturbations--Hspa9, Atp2a2, Hspa5, Opa1 and Gfpt1--whereas the strongest negative correlations were weak and had no significant opposite Elp2-program genes.
finding_consequence: The unsupervised screen linked Elp2 to a terminal stress state shared with mitochondrial chaperone, ER calcium and hexosamine/UPR perturbations, not to a robust antagonistic program.
literature_rationale: The active proteostasis and organelle-stress comparators support coarse positive convergence with the Elp2 stress program. The weak negative neighbors lack coherent significant opposition and are excluded rather than interpreted as antagonists.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Elp2 stress in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut coincided with loss of mature synaptic and neurite genes, including Slc17a7, Grin2c, Camk2a, Cacna1g, Adgrb1 and microtubule genes.
finding_consequence: The response has a neuronal-output arm: the cells that induced amino-acid stress simultaneously reduced excitatory-transmission and neurite-structure transcripts that could act as readouts of stressed projection neurons.
literature_rationale: The coordinated reduction of synaptic, neurite, and cytoskeletal transcripts is a coherent neuronal-output program directly compatible with target-specific Elp2 neuronal morphology and connectivity defects. The exact subtype and RNA markers are contextual.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: A nuclear RNA-processing module was also depressed in the robust 151 response and was represented by the isolated Srsf5 hit in 155 MB Glut.
finding_consequence: Elp2 loss therefore affected a secondary RNA/nuclear-state axis in addition to translation stress, but the module was narrow and cell-state restricted.
literature_rationale: The numerous compatible RNA-processing genes in the well-powered 151 response support a secondary atlas program despite lacking a target-specific literature bridge. The isolated Srsf5 call in 155 is too sparse to establish recurrence and is excluded from placement.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Measurable pathway-adjacent perturbations Trmt1, Eif2ak4, Atf6 and Mtor did not reproduce the 151 Elp2 signature.
finding_consequence: The Elp2 state is not a generic consequence of any tRNA modification, upstream ISR-kinase, ATF6, or mTOR perturbation in the screen.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: The screen recovered a postmitotic proteostasis/ISR arm of ELP2 biology but not the broad neurogenesis, heterotopia or myelination phenotypes described for constitutive ELP2 disease models.
finding_consequence: Disease mechanisms caused by biallelic developmental ELP2 variants cannot be read directly from late sparse LoF in already specified neurons; the assay instead isolates which mature neurons still show acute stress after P16.

finding_summary: Sec31a produced a neuronal response not phenocopied by assayed COPII and early-secretory neighbors, including an engaged but transcriptionally buffered Sec23a perturbation.
finding_consequence: SEC31A is a physical COPII coat partner of SEC13/SEC23/SEC24/SAR1, so the dataset argues that the outer-coat Sec31a node is more transcriptionally limiting than the assayed inner-coat or trafficking neighbors in these neurons, or that paralog buffering differs across COPII components.
literature_rationale: The references establish physical pathway membership and subunit organization, but pathway proximity alone does not document a target-specific transcriptional phenocopy expectation. They therefore neither support nor oppose the observed Sec31a-specific divergence.
cell_types: 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA; 155 MB Glut

finding_summary: Sec31a did not induce a canonical UPR transcriptional program in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, although Hspa5 perturbation demonstrated that this cell group could express an ER-stress response.
finding_consequence: Human SEC31A-null cells were reported to increase ER-stress pathways; the Perturb-seq response instead separates Sec31a's neuronal signature from a broad detectable unfolded-protein response in at least this thalamic context.
literature_rationale: The literature directly links SEC31A loss to increased ER-stress responses, while the informative neuronal result found no canonical UPR induction despite a same-cell Hspa5 positive control. This is a specific directional disagreement, tempered by loss severity and model-context differences.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Sec31a loss produced a sharply partial neuronal transcriptomic response rather than a ubiquitous housekeeping phenotype: 6 of 20 measured cell groups responded, with 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA and 155 MB Glut carrying 165 of the 184 FDR<0.10 downstream tests.
finding_consequence: The response surface refines the broad COPII expectation: a core ER-export coat can be transcriptionally consequential only in selected postmitotic neuronal contexts in a P16 mosaic screen.
literature_rationale: The response concentration in 066 and 155 remains meaningful after the supplied baseline and power checks, although the literature does not predict the mature-neuronal distribution.
cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut; 022 L5 ET CTX Glut; 046 CTX-CGE GABA; 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut

finding_summary: The broad 155 MB Glut response up-regulated an ER-Golgi/coatomer module, including Sec23a, Copa, Copb1, Arfgap1, Gbf1, Golgb1, Gorasp2, Zfpl1, and Srpr, and sparser responders induced Srpr, Stx5a, Golgb1, or Mlec.
finding_consequence: These positive coat and Golgi genes make the Sec31a phenotype look buffered and homeostatic rather than a simple collapse of secretory-pathway transcription.
literature_rationale: The recurrent, signed coatomer and ER-Golgi induction is a coherent program. Target-linked adaptive ER-stress evidence is relevant, but it does not establish this specific compensation module.
cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut; 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut

finding_summary: Sec31a down-regulated mature neuronal and excitability genes across 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA and 155 MB Glut, including Atp1a3, Atp1b1, Kcna2, Kcnc1, Stmn3, Vamp1, Nefl, Ndrg4, Adam23, and Nat8l; the sparse 005 and 151 signatures also contained Grin2b, Lrfn5, Slc8a2, Gabbr2, and Add2 decreases.
finding_consequence: The most recurrent positive biology is a loss of mature membrane/neuronal features downstream of ER-export stress, not induction of canonical UPR genes.
literature_rationale: Concordant loss of neuronal and excitability features is well resolved in the two broad responders and supported by related decreases in sparse responders, but neurological phenotypes alone do not specifically bridge Sec31a loss to this signed RNA program.
cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut; 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut

finding_summary: The top positive restricted-signature neighbors of Sec31a were not same-complex COPII genes but perturbations of acidification or glycosylation-adjacent biology: Atp6v0c, Snf8, Dhdds, and Gfpt1, with Atp6v0c, Dhdds, and Gfpt1 matching Sec31a significant genes in the same direction in 151 TH and 155 MB Glut.
finding_consequence: The cross-screen result places Sec31a in a broader secretory/endolysosomal proteostasis module and nominates V-ATPase, dolichol/N-glycosylation, and hexosamine biosynthesis as functional neighbors in these neurons.
literature_rationale: Atp6v0c, Dhdds, and Gfpt1 support an informative same-direction relationship through repeated exact overlaps; Snf8 is excluded as noninformative. General membrane-proteostasis adjacency is not a specific literature bridge.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut

finding_summary: The two broad signatures repressed energy and mitochondrial transcripts, especially in 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA: Mdh1, Ldhb, Pkm, Ckb, Vdac1, Ndufa11, Ndufs2, Sdhb, Atp5b, and Atp5pb were down in 066, while Pkm, Got1, and Ndufa13 were down in 155 MB Glut.
finding_consequence: The response links Sec31a perturbation to reduced metabolic capacity in the same cells that lose ion-channel and synaptic transcripts, a plausible secondary cost of secretory stress.
literature_rationale: The coordinated metabolic and mitochondrial decrease is a coherent secondary program in informative signatures, but no supplied source specifically connects Sec31a perturbation to this signed effect.
cell_types: 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA; 155 MB Glut

finding_summary: Sec31a loss reduced an extracellular/pericellular transcript set: Bcan and Sema7a in 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA and Sparcl1 in both 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA and 155 MB Glut.
finding_consequence: Matrix and surface-cue transcripts mark secretory cargo classes whose down-regulation is coherent with ER-export perturbation but distinct from the ion-channel signature.
literature_rationale: The positive transcriptomic program is credible within well-powered responses and is biologically distinct from the existing mature-neuronal withdrawal finding. The claim is narrowed to transcript reduction because COPII cargo export does not establish transcriptional causality.
cell_types: 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA; 155 MB Glut

finding_summary: In 155 MB Glut, a degradative/vacuolar segment was reduced rather than transcriptionally induced: Atp6v0a1, Ctsb, Psap, and Vps39 were all negative.
finding_consequence: The direction is opposite to a simple compensatory lysosome/autophagy induction model and reinforces that Sec31a loss produced a mixed buffered state.
literature_rationale: The supported claim is the reduced degradative/autophagy-associated program in 155 MB Glut. Direct Sec31a interference reduces autophagy in the same qualitative direction; the listed Atp6v0c context is not needed as a comparator claim.
cell_types: 155 MB Glut

finding_summary: The 046 CTX-CGE GABA response was restricted to a single up-regulated redox/electron-transfer gene, Ndor1, despite 46 perturbed cells.
finding_consequence: This keeps the CGE response as a real but pathway-sparse signal and avoids merging it into the stronger 066 inhibitory program.

finding_consequence: The expected same-pathway comparison is an informative negative result: the Sec31a signature is not a generic readout of weakly perturbing any COPII or COPI component in this screen.

finding_summary: Several Cltc responder classes repressed synaptic vesicle, receptor and channel transcripts.
finding_consequence: The down arm matches the expected vulnerability of synaptic membrane traffic to clathrin loss but shows it as a secondary nuclear program: cortical and midbrain glutamatergic cells lost Rph3a/Snap25/Gria genes, Pvalb cells lost Gabrd/Slc6a1/Sv2a/Kcnc1/Scn1a, CNU-HYa/HY GABA lost Unc13a/Gria4/Scn8a, and TH Prkcd/Grin2c cells lost Gabra4/Gabbr1/Grid2ip.
literature_rationale: Cltc depletion directly impairs synaptic-vesicle and receptor traffic in the same qualitative direction as the coherent repression program. Exact transcripts and neuronal groups are distribution context, not missing mechanistic edges.
cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut; 052 Pvalb Gaba; 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut

finding_summary: The induced arm of the Cltc signature carried AP-1/ISR and pro-death markers, with Jun as the most repeated stress transcription factor and Bcl2l11 or Hrk appearing in the narrowest vulnerable groups.
finding_consequence: Jun was up in Pvalb, CNU-HYa/HY GABA, MB Glut and CB GABA; Ddit3 was up in CNU-HYa/HY GABA and MB/P/MY GABA; Bcl2l11 was up in CB GABA; Hrk and Srxn1 were up in CNU-HYa/HY GABA. These genes are a candidate stress readout for neurons whose endomembrane traffic has exceeded a homeostatic threshold.
literature_rationale: The recurrent AP-1/ISR stress arm is coherent, with a narrower pro-death component, but the supplied sources do not establish the consequential CLTC-loss-to-Jun/DDIT3 induction edge.
cell_types: 052 Pvalb Gaba; 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA; 155 MB Glut; 191 MB P MY GABA; 308 CB GABA

finding_summary: Cltc responders induced a small vesicle/endolysosomal compensation arm.
finding_consequence: Atp8b2 recurred in three responder classes and Ctsb, Psap, Gaa, Clcn3, Rab15, Tfrc and Atp6ap2 were induced in subsets, consistent with attempts to adjust vesicle-cargo or lysosomal handling after clathrin-coated traffic is disturbed.
literature_rationale: Multiple induced genes support a modest vesicle/endolysosomal handling program, but the source establishes CLTC's compartmental role rather than the direction of this transcriptional compensation.

finding_summary: The strongest unexpected positive neighbor was an endolysosomal acidification/vesicle-traffic axis rather than the AP-2 coated-pit module.
finding_consequence: Atp6v0c matched 35 of 36 significant Cltc coordinates in the same direction and Vps37a, Tsc1 and Tsc2 also showed same-direction overlaps, placing the Cltc RNA state closer to endolysosomal stress than to a simple AP-2 knockdown state.
literature_rationale: All four comparators were active, and the relationship rests on extensive same-direction coordinate overlap rather than neighbor rank alone. Literature supports endolysosomal proximity but not the shared signed response state or its ordering relative to AP-2.

finding_summary: Proteasome perturbations unexpectedly phenocopied Cltc across the exact responder coordinates.
finding_consequence: Psmb4, Psmc1, Psmc5 and Pomp produced 112/117, 77/80, 57/60 and 52/56 same-direction significant overlaps on Cltc coordinates, nominating a shared protein-quality-control or damage-response state that would not be inferred from the clathrin complex alone.
literature_rationale: The four proteasome perturbations were highly informative and showed overwhelming signed overlap with Cltc, supporting a biological convergence claim despite the absence of a CLTC-specific literature bridge.

finding_summary: A postmitotic Cltc LoF-like perturbation was sufficient to elicit synaptic repression and stress in selected juvenile neurons.
finding_consequence: CLTC-related developmental-delay and epileptic-encephalopathy genetics is usually interpreted in a brain-development frame, but this P16 perturbation acted after neuronal specification and still produced synaptic and stress signatures. Postnatal neuronal trafficking stress is therefore a plausible component of CLTC disease biology, distinct from embryonic morphogenesis.
literature_rationale: The postmitotic synaptic and stress response remains a biological interpretation, while its observed cellular distribution is only context. Direct evidence supports postmitotic synaptic impairment, but not the AP-1/ISR component or its contribution to human disease.

finding_summary: P16 Cltc loss triggered an FDR-supported nuclear response in only 8 of 18 measured neuronal groups, not a pan-neuronal response.
finding_consequence: Cltc is a housekeeping vesicle-scaffold gene, so the key result is not simple ubiquity: only L4/5 IT, Pvalb, CNU-HYa/HY GABA, hypothalamic/mammillary glutamate, TH Prkcd/Grin2c glutamate, MB glutamate, MB/P/MY GABA and CB GABA crossed the FDR threshold.

finding_summary: Textbook AP-2, fission, uncoating and phosphoinositide comparators did not reproduce the Cltc state.
finding_consequence: AP2M1/AP2S1, DNM1/DNM2, DNAJC6/HSPA8 and SYNJ1 are obvious clathrin-cycle genes, yet only Ap2s1 had a small 15-gene same-direction overlap and all others had zero FDR-supported overlaps on the Cltc coordinates. The Cltc response therefore reflects loss of the heavy-chain scaffold across several trafficking routes, or a severity threshold, rather than any one CME accessory step.

finding_summary: Mib1 converged on sterol-gene induction with trafficking, ER-lipid, and nutrient-state perturbations including Dctn1, Dync1h1, Chp1, Rab7, Tsc1/Tsc2, and Marchf6.

Regional Atp1a3 expression supports plausibility but does not establish perturbation-selective responsiveness.

finding_summary: The thalamic responder rewired ion and calcium-handling transcripts after Atp1a3 loss: Atp2a2 and Atp2b1 fell, Kcnj9 and Cacna1d fell, whereas Grin2a, Ache, Slc17a6, Scn1b, and Kcnab3 rose.

finding_summary: Cacna1g was the top positive restricted-signature neighbor of Atp1a3 and retained a compact same-direction thalamic overlap with Ptprn and Notum up and Rgs16, Lrrc7, Zdhhc22, Ly6e, Cpne7, and Stmn4 down.

finding_summary: Atp6v0c, Rab7, Hspa9, and Atp2a2 produced much larger 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut signatures that partially overlapped Atp1a3, whereas nominal neighbors such as Dync1h1, Alk, Rhobtb2, and Hdac5 failed robust validation.

The null or sparse nominal neighbors are only rejected search context and cannot contribute to the biological relationship.

Its absence despite other transcriptional responses is directionally opposite, although partial acute perturbation versus complete conditional ablation and potentially delayed kinetics limit transportability.

The thalamic location cannot bear a selectivity claim because group 151 has the highest response baseline.

literature_rationale: The references establish Pol II biology, CNS importance, and disease association, but none documents the observed proteasome/spliceosome convergence. General RNA-processing or transcriptional proximity is insufficient to bridge this comparator relationship.

finding_summary: In 151 and 110, Slc7a6os loss also recruited membrane-trafficking, ER/lysosomal, calcium, chaperone, and metabolic genes rather than a purely nuclear RNA signature.
finding_consequence: Genes such as Atp6v1b2, Gnptg, Aup1, Uchl1, Atp2a2, Atp2b1, Eps15, Vps54, Laptm4a, Acadvl, Ldhd, Pgam1, Chchd2, Dnaja1, and Cct8 show that selected neurons couple Pol II-import stress to proteostasis/trafficking and energetic remodeling.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut; 191 MB P MY GABA; 052 Pvalb Gaba

finding_consequence: The replicated 005/007 core argues that Mef2c loss in postmitotic cortical IT neurons rewires mature synaptic-vesicle and glutamatergic transcripts rather than producing an idiosyncratic one-cell-type hit list.

cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut; 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut

finding_summary: Celf2, not a MEF2 paralog, was the dominant FDR-level cross-perturbation neighbor: it shared 17 significant Mef2c dimensions, 16 in the same direction, across 005, 007, and 151.
finding_consequence: The Celf2 result nominates an RNA-processing perturbation as the closest measurable partner of the acute Mef2c transcriptomic state, whereas several more obvious MEF2-pathway targets failed the FDR-overlap test.
literature_rationale: Celf2 is highly active and shares 16 of 17 significant dimensions in the same direction across three reported groups. This is a coherent positive convergence relationship, although no source-specific Mef2c–Celf2 bridge is supplied.
cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut; 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Gria2 was the only downstream gene up at FDR<0.10 in both cortical IT responders and in the Pvalb response.
finding_consequence: Recurrent, same-direction Gria2 up-regulation gives a compact marker of the shared MEF2C-sensitive glutamatergic component, despite the Pvalb response containing only seven FDR-significant genes.
cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut; 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut; 052 Pvalb Gaba

finding_summary: Acute P16 Mef2c loss generated a strongly cell-type-restricted response: 49 and 50 downstream genes in L4/5 and L2/3 IT cortical glutamatergic neurons, only 7 genes in Pvalb interneurons, 3 genes in TH Prkcd/Grin2c glutamatergic neurons, and no FDR<0.10 downstream genes in the other 19 measured groups.
finding_consequence: MEF2C is a broad developmental and disease gene, but this single-cell screen localizes its detectable young-postnatal, cell-autonomous transcriptional liability chiefly to IT cortical neurons after cortical fates are already specified.
cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut; 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut; 052 Pvalb Gaba; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Mef2c loss in the cortical IT responders coupled Ras/calcium signaling changes to ion-channel remodeling: Rasgrf1 and Rasal1 rose, Rasgrf2 and Spred1 fell, and channel-associated genes Kcnk4, Kcnh5, Cacna2d1, Cacnb3, and Kcnip2 were reduced across cortical or Pvalb responders.
finding_consequence: Because MEF2 is normally an activity-regulated transcription factor, opposing Ras-family regulators and reduced channel auxiliary or leak-current genes look like a compensatory attempt to retune neuronal activity after losing a synaptic transcriptional brake.
cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut; 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut; 052 Pvalb Gaba

finding_summary: Direct Pvalb editing recovered only a seven-gene echo of the cortical program, with Rph3a and Gria2 up and Kcnip2, Dock4, Cemip, and Abtb3 down, whereas the other measured GABA classes had no FDR-significant downstream genes.
finding_consequence: This separates a narrow postnatal Pvalb-intrinsic MEF2C response from the large inhibitory-synapse phenotypes seen when Mef2c is removed embryonically from cortical excitatory lineages.
cell_types: 052 Pvalb Gaba

finding_summary: Mef2a, Mef2d, Hdac4, Hdac5, calcium/CaM kinase and calcineurin subunits, and CBP/p300 did not phenocopy Mef2c in the matched responder cell types; even Mef2d, a positive restricted-vector neighbor, had zero FDR<0.10 downstream genes in 005, 007, 052, and 151.
finding_consequence: The acute P16 state is MEF2C-specific rather than a generic MEF2-family or MEF2-HDAC-axis collapse, so pathway membership alone would have predicted the wrong cross-perturbation neighbors.
cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut; 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut; 052 Pvalb Gaba; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Representative neurodevelopmental-disorder genes Chd8, Tbr1, and Fmr1, and the Foxp2 perturbation expected to oppose Mef2c in corticostriatal wiring, did not converge on the Mef2c signature.
finding_consequence: MEF2C haploinsufficiency biology in this dataset is not a generic ASD/ID transcriptional state; the recovered program is a narrow postnatal cortical IT module with only sparse overlap to other single-gene disease perturbations.
cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut; 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut; 052 Pvalb Gaba; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Zmynd8 perturbation recurrently increased Zfp532 RNA in multiple responder groups, nominating a transcriptional response within the ZMYND8-associated chromatin-partner network.
finding_consequence: The response includes a transcript encoding a known physical partner of ZMYND8 rather than only downstream neuronal effectors, which nominates Zfp532 as a compact marker of perturbing this chromatin-reader assembly.
literature_rationale: The recurrent Zfp532 increase is biologically connected to a documented ZMYND8 partner, but physical association alone does not predict compensatory transcriptional upregulation.

finding_summary: The 151 response included down-regulation of synaptic and neurite-associated genes rather than wholesale activation of a neuronal differentiation module.
finding_consequence: ZMYND8 had been linked to neuronal differentiation, but the P16 thalamic phenotype looked like a mature-neuron synaptic weakening superimposed on a stress/ectopic module.
literature_rationale: Direct ZMYND8 loss impairs the same signed neuronal-lineage program. The mature thalamic placement is descriptive context and does not weaken the program-level agreement.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: The strongest induced 151 genes formed an ectopic secretory, lipid and calcium-handling state led by Ptgds, Lhcgr, Capn3, Abhd12b, Atp2a1 and Myo5c.
finding_consequence: These high-amplitude genes, not canonical Wnt or MAPT, define the measurable postmitotic Zmynd8-null state in this screen.
literature_rationale: The strong multi-gene secretory, lipid, and calcium-handling state is coherent, but the cited target-specific evidence supports only pathway proximity to its lipid arm and does not predict its direction after Zmynd8 loss.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Redox and ER/chaperone genes were recruited inside the 151 signature, with Msra and Sil1 among the most significant induced transcripts.
finding_consequence: This points to a secondary adaptive state after chromatin-reader loss rather than a purely developmental transcription-factor phenotype.
literature_rationale: The redox and chaperone response is supported by multiple compatible genes. ZMYND8 loss directly increases oxidative stress, but the neuronal ER/chaperone compensation remains an incomplete extension.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: The strongest data-driven positive neighbors of Zmynd8 were Kdm5c, Ehmt1 and Nsd1, which re-induced the same high-amplitude 151 genes.
finding_consequence: The Zmynd8 module is part of a broader chromatin-regulator vulnerability surface in thalamic neurons, not merely an isolated NuRD or ZMYND-family effect.
literature_rationale: Kdm5c and Nsd1 have informative focused responses with coherent same-direction overlap, while Ehmt1 is weaker. The supported convergence is centered on the 151 program; the isolated 005 observation is not part of that program.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Chd4, the NuRD ATPase most directly linked to ZMYND8 in DNA-damage literature, partially phenocopied Zmynd8 but also inverted part of the signature.
finding_consequence: The result supports a real Zmynd8/NuRD connection in postmitotic neurons while showing that acute Chd4 loss is not simply equivalent to Zmynd8 loss.
literature_rationale: Both Zmynd8 and Chd4 have strong local response surfaces, and their mixed concordant and discordant overlap supports partial convergence with real non-equivalence. Literature predicts shared but nonidentical effects without specifying the observed signed partition.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Arid2 was anticorrelated with Zmynd8 in the same 151 thalamic features, flipping 9 of 10 shared FDR genes.
finding_consequence: Chromatin perturbations are directionally separable in this neuronal state: not every chromatin-regulator loss produces the Zmynd8/Kdm5c-like thalamic program.
literature_rationale: Arid2 is an active comparator and reverses nine of ten shared significant genes, making the opposing relationship load-bearing. No source specifically predicts this signed relationship.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Extra-thalamic Zmynd8 effects collapsed to a tiny recurrent marker set: Myo5c in cortical L4/5 plus 151, and Spag5 and Hexim2 recurring in midbrain/thalamic glutamatergic groups.
finding_consequence: Spag5, Hexim2 and Myo5c are better biomarkers of weak Zmynd8 engagement in this assay than the target transcript itself, which did not fall.
cell_types: 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut; 145 MH-LH TH Glut; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut; 027 NP-CT-L6b-OB Glut

finding_summary: Zmynd8 loss of function was not a pan-neuronal transcriptional perturbation; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut carried 93 of 99 FDR<0.10 downstream cell-group/gene calls, while four other groups only produced one to three genes each.
finding_consequence: This sharply localizes the postnatal NeuN+ response to a thalamic excitatory state and prevents the many zeroes elsewhere from being misread as a failed perturbation.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 005 L4-5 IT CTX Glut; 027 NP-CT-L6b-OB Glut; 145 MH-LH TH Glut; 155 MB Glut

finding_summary: The screen did not recover the published MAPT or PRC2/Wnt developmental programs even in the strong 151 response.
finding_consequence: Zmynd8 disease risk need not be modeled by acute postmitotic gene-level LoF alone; interaction-disrupting missense alleles, isoform regulation, embryonic neural stem cells and astrocytes remain plausible disease-relevant axes.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: The Pvalb Caml signature links the known GABA_A-receptor trafficking role of CAML to a Pvalb transcriptional feedback state with Gabrg2, Gria2, Kcnip2, and Cntnap5a down and Rhoq/Rab15/Stmn4 up.
finding_consequence: The screen recovered a receptor/adhesion downshift in exactly the interneuron class where impaired inhibitory postsynaptic receptor recycling is most interpretable, nominating Gabrg2 down-regulation as a secondary biomarker rather than as a direct measure of surface receptor loss.
literature_rationale: The direct CAML-to-GABA_A-receptor trafficking mechanism is relevant to the Gabrg2-centered phenotype, but it does not predict the full transcriptional program or the recurrent Stmn4 response.
cell_types: 052 Pvalb Gaba; 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA; 191 MB P MY GABA

finding_summary: TH Prkcd Grin2c and MB Glut responders share a neuronal-maintenance decline, with synaptic vesicle, ion-transport, receptor, adhesion, and tubulin genes reduced after Caml perturbation.
finding_consequence: Human CAMLG disease is neurologic and linked to membrane trafficking; the mouse screen localizes one possible postmitotic manifestation to loss of synaptic-vesicle and excitability transcripts, including Syp, Sv2a, Atp1a3, Slc12a5, Thy1, and Tubb2a/Tubb3/Tubb4a.
literature_rationale: Both groups show a multi-gene neuronal-maintenance decline with demonstrated Caml RNA reduction. CAMLG deficiency supports neurological and trafficking consequences but does not establish this signed synaptic, excitability, adhesion, and tubulin program.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut

finding_summary: The strongest validated non-literature neighbors of Caml were v-ATPase/endolysosomal and clathrin perturbations, led by Atp6v0c and Cltc.
finding_consequence: The top positive neighbor scan nominated trafficking rather than CAML's absent same-complex partners; Atp6v0c shared 40 Caml FDR features all in the same direction and Cltc shared 9, placing the Caml RNA state near vesicle acidification and coated-vesicle biology.
literature_rationale: Atp6v0c and Cltc have informative response surfaces and validated same-direction overlap with Caml, so the convergence is more than neighbor geometry. Vps53 was already rejected, and no CAML-specific source predicts the retained v-ATPase/clathrin relationship.
cell_types: 052 Pvalb Gaba; 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut; 191 MB P MY GABA

finding_consequence: Psmb4, Psmc5, Psmc1, and Pomp recapitulated many Caml-direction features, yet Psmb4 alone caused more than one thousand FDR genes in multiple classes where Caml had tens or fewer; this separates a common proteostasis/synaptic-stress endpoint from the selective Caml effect.
literature_rationale: All proteasome comparators are active and reproduce multiple Caml-direction features, while their orders-of-magnitude broader surfaces establish informative partial convergence rather than full phenocopy. No target-specific literature bridge predicts this relationship.
cell_types: 052 Pvalb Gaba; 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut; 191 MB P MY GABA

finding_summary: Caml responders induced a small AP-1/CREM/Stmn4 remodeling module rather than a uniform terminal stress program.
finding_consequence: Jun was the top event in CNU-HYa HY GABA and reappeared in MB Glut, Crem and Dusp1 rose in TH Prkcd Grin2c, and Stmn4 was induced in three GABAergic responder groups; this points to compensatory cytoskeletal/immediate-early remodeling layered on the synaptic downshift.
cell_types: 052 Pvalb Gaba; 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut; 191 MB P MY GABA

cell_types: 052 Pvalb Gaba; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut; 191 MB P MY GABA

finding_summary: Active Slc17a5 responders showed a recurrent downshift of synaptic, calcium-regulatory, chaperone, and neuronal structural transcripts including Snap25, Ppp3r1, Hsp90aa1, Tuba1a, Tubb3, and Ncdn.
finding_consequence: Sialin has a documented synaptic-vesicle transport role for aspartate/glutamate and NAAG, so the recurrent neuronal/synaptic down-module is a candidate transcriptomic readout of perturbed vesicular neurotransmitter handling.
literature_rationale: The literature supplies a specific vesicular-transport hypothesis but neither predicts the observed RNA direction nor resolves conflicting evidence about that proposed neuronal function.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut; 191 MB P MY GABA

finding_summary: The main thalamic responder up-regulated lysosomal/endolysosomal genes after Slc17a5 perturbation, including Dpp7, Lamp2, Grn, Neu1, Fnip2, Slc2a6, and Appl2.
finding_consequence: These genes are directionally consistent with a neuron sensing lysosomal membrane-export stress and mounting a degradative/trafficking compensation rather than only losing a synaptic-vesicle function.
literature_rationale: A Slc17a5 disease-model allele directly produced lysosomal catabolic transcription in the same direction as the observed Lamp2, Neu1, Grn, Dpp7, and related endolysosomal increases.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut

finding_summary: Slc17a5 repeatedly induced an Insig1-centered lipid/sterol feedback program: Insig1 was FDR-significant in all four responder classes, and Msmo1 plus Dhcr24 were co-induced in 155 MB Glut.
finding_consequence: A single recurrent transcript across all responders points to membrane-lipid or sterol feedback as the most portable secondary response to neuronal Slc17a5 loss.
literature_rationale: Recurrent Insig1 induction plus the signed three-gene sterol module supports a secondary lipid-feedback program. Target-specific literature establishes lipid remodeling but not this INSIG1-centered program.
cell_types: 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut; 191 MB P MY GABA

finding_summary: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut showed a coordinated secondary downshift of chaperone, ubiquitin-like, glycolytic, and mitochondrial carrier transcripts, with a partial chaperone/ubiquitin echo in 155 MB Glut.
finding_consequence: This marks Slc17a5 loss as a mixed lysosomal-plus-proteostasis perturbation in the strongest responder rather than a response limited to the canonical sialic-acid exporter pathway.
literature_rationale: Multiple concordant chaperone, ubiquitin-like, metabolic, and mitochondrial-carrier decreases form a coherent program in 151, with a limited supportive echo in 155. No target-specific literature bridge was supplied.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut

finding_summary: Uba5 was the strongest robust anti-neighbor of Slc17a5, reversing many of the Slc17a5 significant calls in both 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut and 155 MB Glut.
finding_consequence: The inverse UFMylation signature argues that the Slc17a5/TSC-like state is not just the generic direction taken by every broad neuronal stress perturbation.
literature_rationale: Uba5 is highly active on the relevant surfaces, and opposite-direction overlaps substantially exceed same-direction overlaps in 151 and 155. This is informative divergence rather than null-comparator non-phenocopy, although no literature bridge predicts it.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut; 191 MB P MY GABA

finding_summary: Slc17a5 loss produced a real but restricted neuronal response: 90 FDR<0.10 gene-by-cell calls were confined to 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut, 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, 155 MB Glut, and 191 MB P MY GABA, with 19 other measured groups FDR-flat.
finding_consequence: The disease gene is not transcriptionally inert in this P16 mosaic neuronal assay, but its response is concentrated in thalamic and midbrain/hindbrain neuronal classes rather than cortex or hippocampus.
cell_types: 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut; 191 MB P MY GABA

finding_summary: Among proton-gradient pathway comparators, Atp6v0c converged with Slc17a5 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, whereas Atp6v0a1 and Atp6v1a did not show FDR-level phenocopy despite Atp6v0a1 ranking high by restricted cosine.
finding_consequence: The comparison ties the Slc17a5 response to lysosomal acidification biology but shows that not every V-ATPase subunit perturbation reproduces the same neuronal state.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut; 191 MB P MY GABA

finding_summary: Tsc1 and Tsc2 were strong same-direction signature neighbors of Slc17a5 across the thalamic and midbrain responders, while Mtor and Rb1cc1 did not provide FDR-level phenocopy.

finding_consequence: This negative result refines interpretation of the screen: a post-P16 NeuN+ neuronal perturbation can reveal cell-autonomous lysosomal stress, but it cannot stand in for the earlier oligodendrocyte/myelination axis that dominates mouse and human FSASD pathology.

finding_summary: The thalamic Esrra signature recovered the expected nuclear mitochondrial energy-metabolism program.
finding_consequence: Down-regulation of Mdh1/Got1/Mpc1/Dlat/Idh3a/Idh3b together with Ndufs2/Uqcrc1/Cyc1 is the direction expected from losing a PGC-1–ERRα transcriptional activator and anchors the screen hit in known ERRα biology rather than in an unrelated stress artifact.

finding_summary: Esrra loss was not a pan-mitochondrial-biogenesis, ISR, UPR, or autophagy crisis.
finding_consequence: The assay would have detected secondary stress transcription if acute ERRα loss caused severe respiratory failure over 3–4 weeks, but Ppargc1a/Ppargc1b/Nrf1/Tfam/Perm1 and Atf4/Ddit3/Hspa5/Xbp1/Sqstm1/Map1lc3b were not FDR-significant, narrowing the phenotype to a selected metabolic and neuronal-effector program.
literature_rationale: The responsive 151 surface had adequate local power to test the nominated transcripts, supporting a bounded absence of the measured broad biogenesis and stress programs. Literature specifically motivates the mitochondrial-biogenesis test but does not predict ISR, UPR, autophagy, or every tested marker.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: The strongest noncanonical Esrra responder genes were secreted or extracellular-matrix-associated transcripts.
finding_consequence: Gas6, Bcan, Spock2, Sema7a, Vegfa and Adamts-family decreases, with Pxdn in the opposite direction, show that the real thalamic response extends beyond respiratory-chain genes and may include remodeling of neuron–environment or perineuronal-matrix signaling in surviving Esrra-perturbed neurons.
literature_rationale: The extracellular and secreted-gene changes form a coherent secondary program within a well-powered signature, but supplied ESRRA evidence provides no specific bridge to that program.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Esrra coupled the mitochondrial hit to ion-transport, axonal and synaptic transcripts in the same thalamic cells.

literature_rationale: Direct Esrra-null and ERRα-inhibition experiments reproduce representative neuronal, axonal, synaptic, and metabolic decreases. Esrrg is literature context rather than a load-bearing dataset comparator.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: The dominant convergent structure around the Esrra signature was negative and non-obvious: Celf2, Cic, Bmal1 and Nr1d1 opposed the Esrra thalamic program.

finding_summary: Acute Esrra loss produced a single robust response, confined to 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut.
finding_consequence: The result converts an apparently ubiquitous metabolic nuclear receptor into a sharply state- or cell-class-restricted dependency in this P16-to-P37/44 mosaic neuronal LoF screen; similar or larger self-transcript decreases in other groups did not produce downstream DE.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: The expected ESRR/PGC/PPAR relatives were measured but largely failed to phenocopy Esrra.
finding_consequence: Ppargc1a was the top weak full-transcriptome neighbor, yet it had no FDR-significant genes; Esrrb, Esrrg, Ppargc1b, Ppara, Ppard, Pparg, Ncoa1, Ncoa3 and Nfe2l2 were also flat in 151, while Nrf1 produced a separate 189-gene response with essentially zero Esrra correlation. The PGC-1–ERRα axis is therefore not interchangeable with single loss of its obvious partners in this assay.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut neurons, Grin1 perturbation produced a broad transcriptional response whereas Grin2b perturbation produced only a minimal response.
finding_consequence: The divergence separates a shared core receptor requirement from GluN2B-specific dependence in a thalamic glutamatergic state and argues against treating any NMDA-receptor subunit knockdown as a generic proxy for all others.
literature_rationale: Receptor-assembly evidence establishes the shared GRIN1–GRIN2B complex, and subunit-diversity evidence establishes that GluN2 identity is variable rather than interchangeable with the obligatory receptor core. Together these links predict the observed broader Grin1 response and buffered Grin2b response. Confidence is moderated by the stronger measured Grin1 knockdown.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Grin2b loss produced a substantial transcriptional response in cortical projection-neuron groups, strongest in 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut, while engaged Pvalb neurons lacked a downstream response.
finding_consequence: The response is restricted to a subset of cortical excitatory neurons even though NMDA receptors are broadly neuronal, so the screen refines GluN2B biology to a P16-P44 cell-state window rather than recapitulating all NMDAR functions.
literature_rationale: The full brain-wide restriction claim exceeded the power evidence, but the locally engaged Pvalb contrast and exceptional cortical response support a narrower cell-type boundary.

That complete signed chain predicts the observed reduction of the recurring activity-regulated program; exact genes and cortical placement are resolution details.

Prior GRIN2B-loss evidence supports altered neuronal and synaptic function but does not establish this signed active-zone/postsynaptic transcriptional program.

finding_summary: The strongest FDR-gated positive replay was Ap2s1, which phenocopied 7 of 9 Grin2b L4/5 cortical genes in the same direction and also shared the tiny Pianp and Cbarp decreases in the thalamic and midbrain one-gene responders.

The thalamic and midbrain singleton matches are too sparse and baseline-prone to carry the relationship, while AP-2 binding to NR2B does not independently fix the perturbation-direction edge.

finding_summary: Grin2a and Kcnb1 opposed the Grin2b cortical state by increasing activity-associated genes: Grin2a induced Nptx2, Scg2, and Bdnf in L2/3 or L4/5, and Kcnb1 induced Bdnf, Vgf, Scg2, and Nptx2 in L4/5.
finding_consequence: Grin2a is the closest literature paralog, yet it did not phenocopy Grin2b; the screen resolves GluN2A and GluN2B as directionally distinct levers on postnatal cortical activity genes.
literature_rationale: Grin2a and Kcnb1 have active matched cortical response surfaces with signed activity-gene increases contrasting with the Grin2b decrease. Kcnb1's upward activity arm has external support, but the opposite Grin2a relationship remains mechanistically unestablished.

Direct Pten studies establish synaptic and excitability effects but do not predict—and partly conflict with—the observed reduced synaptic-vesicle RNA component.

The supplied literature establishes feedback complexity in the PTEN-TSC network but not this target-specific signed transcriptional combination.

The two- and five-gene Nf1 responses in groups 155 and 191 are excluded as too weak for fine divergence, and the literature does not predict the specific transcriptomic partition.

This complete directional chain predicts the observed induction program, including its extension into additional neuronal groups.

The multiciliogenesis absence is not load-bearing because its markers have weak local expression and its required progenitor context is absent.

literature_rationale: A target-specific PURA-depletion study supplies a directional expectation for LSM14A and DDX6, whereas the responsive neuronal contexts showed no significant decrease in either transcript.

finding_summary: The strongest Pura responder groups up-regulated axonal and synaptic structural genes, including Nefl in 151, 155, and 191, Tubb2a, Cntnap1, Lingo1, Slitrk6, Pcdh1, Nefh, and Dnm1 or Nlgn2 in 151/155.

finding_summary: Tsc1 and Tsc2 were the clearest FDR-level same-direction neighbors of the Pura signature, sharing 17 and 7 same-direction FDR genes inside the 59 Pura cell-group/gene dimensions.
finding_consequence: This nominates a growth-state or lysosome-adjacent axis as a better empirical comparator for the Pura responder genes than the obvious Pur paralogs.
literature_rationale: Tsc1 and Tsc2 are highly active comparators with exclusively same-direction FDR-supported overlaps, so the empirical convergence is load-bearing rather than neighbor geometry. No supplied target-specific literature bridge connects Pura loss to TSC-loss convergence.

finding_summary: Atp6v0c opposed the Pura restricted signature, with 10 of 12 Atp6v0c FDR hits in the Pura dimensions moving in the opposite direction.
finding_consequence: A lysosomal V-ATPase perturbation inversely tracks many of the Pura TH/MB structural genes, sharpening the growth-state interpretation and providing a directionally negative comparator.

cell_types: 052 Pvalb Gaba; 066 CNU-HYa HY GABA; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut; 191 MB P MY GABA; 308 CB GABA

finding_summary: Purb was the top continuous positive Pura neighbor, but the Pur paralog and measured FMRP/KIF comparators did not phenocopy at the FDR level; broad RBP targets such as Srsf1, Hnrnpu, and Tardbp produced much larger, poorly aligned responses.

finding_summary: The Mdh1 thalamic signature showed a weak same-direction echo with cytosolic Got1 but was not reproduced by the assayed mitochondrial and transporter MAS perturbations.

finding_summary: Mdh1 produced a robust downstream response only in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut: 42 non-Mdh1 genes at FDR<0.10, while 21 other recovered cell groups had zero downstream FDR hits.
finding_consequence: A cytosolic NADH-shuttle enzyme was not transcriptionally essential across postmitotic neurons; vulnerability was concentrated in one thalamic glutamatergic class.

finding_summary: The Mdh1 thalamic signature contained a coordinated decrease of synaptic and ion-homeostasis genes, including Nrxn1, Grin2b, Lrrtm1, Cadm3, Epha4, Gabbr2, Kcnc2, Atp1a1, and Atp2a2.
finding_consequence: This refines MAS-deficiency biology from a purely metabolic lesion to a neuronal state in which redox/metabolic stress is coupled to reduced excitatory-synapse and excitability transcripts.
literature_rationale: The coordinated decrease in synaptic and ion-homeostasis genes is a coherent component of a well-powered response. MDH1 literature establishes the metabolic lesion but not this signed transcriptional consequence.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: The thalamic Mdh1 response included a secondary RNA-processing and protein-turnover branch, with Zcchc7, U2surp, Luc7l2, Hnrnpu, Ddx46, Ube2b, Ubr3, and Snf8 increased and Snrnp70 decreased.

literature_rationale: The recurrent RNA-processing branch, supported secondarily by turnover genes, is coherent within the 42-gene response, but no supplied MDH1-specific source connects the target to this rewiring.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Atp6v0c, Dnm1l, Chp1, and Wac perturbations converged with Mdh1 in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, sharing 13 to 20 of the 42 Mdh1 genes in the same direction.
finding_consequence: The strongest FDR-level neighbors were lysosomal, mitochondrial-fission, calcium, and regulatory perturbations rather than the canonical MAS enzymes, defining a data-driven thalamic stress/synapse module.
literature_rationale: All four comparators have active local surfaces and share many Mdh1 genes with a strong same-direction imbalance, supporting coarse convergence rather than rank-only geometry. No target-specific literature bridge predicts it.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Ddit3, Cars, Gls, Tafazzin, and Bicd2 were up-regulated in the responding thalamic group, indicating a compact stress and amino-acid/mitochondrial compensation branch after Mdh1 loss.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Ap2s1, Naa20, and Zbtb7a produced broad signatures that opposed 11 to 16 Mdh1 thalamic genes at FDR<0.10.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_consequence: This rejects a simple model in which every malate-aspartate-shuttle perturbation creates the same postmitotic thalamic transcriptome; the measurable response is biased toward Mdh1 and, weakly, cytosolic Got1.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Zfp236-assigned responses recurrently lowered Ogt and Eif4a2 across multiple neuronal classes, defining a compact O-GlcNAc/translation-initiation program.

literature_rationale: The target and downstream genes each have relevant annotations, but their separate functions do not constitute a target-to-program bridge.

finding_summary: Zfp236-assigned responses recurrently decreased Cpt1c in hypothalamic, thalamic, midbrain, and pontine/medullary glutamatergic classes.

literature_rationale: The literature establishes the biological importance of CPT1C but supplies no specific Zfp236-to-Cpt1c bridge.
cell_types: 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut; 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 155 MB Glut; 191 MB P MY GABA

finding_summary: The closest data-driven neighbor of Zfp236 was Gfpt1, tying recurrent Ogt down-regulation to a hexosamine/O-GlcNAc metabolic axis.
finding_consequence: Gfpt1 is upstream of UDP-GlcNAc production and Ogt consumes UDP-GlcNAc; their convergence on Ogt down-regulation suggests that the Zfp236 module intersects nutrient-sensitive protein O-GlcNAcylation rather than being an isolated Ogt outlier.
literature_rationale: Gfpt1 has a broad informative response and matches most Zfp236-significant axes, including recurrent Ogt down-regulation, supporting positive convergence. GFPT1–UDP-GlcNAc–OGT biochemistry makes the result interpretable but does not specifically bridge Zfp236 loss to it.

The absence of a downstream proteasome-subunit bounce-back is separated and excluded from the load-bearing comparator claim. No target-specific literature bridge is supplied.

finding_consequence: Cross-perturbation convergence anchors the 55-gene Stag2 signature to cohesin biology rather than to an idiosyncratic guide effect.

finding_summary: The 151 responder genes point to neuronal contact, synaptic, receptor, and neurite remodeling, including strong down-regulation of Ptprm, Necab2, Adamts2/19, Ptprz1, Npy1r, Sema5a, Sez6, Asic2, and Lrrc7 with smaller up-regulation of Gabra1 and Stmn2.

STAG2 loss causes neurodevelopmental and brain transcriptional phenotypes, but the specific mature-neuron program and direction are not established.

finding_summary: Stag2 produced a real but extremely restricted response: 55 FDR<0.10 downstream genes appeared in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, while all other 21 measured groups had zero.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Adnp loss decreased numerous neuronal projection, membrane, and synaptic-specialization transcripts in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut.
finding_consequence: This refines ADNP biology from a generic chromatin essential gene to a postmitotic thalamic-neuron vulnerability in this P16 mosaic assay.

finding_summary: The 151 response included a depressed extracellular-matrix and cell-adhesion module spanning glycosaminoglycan initiation, proteoglycan and receptor/adhesion genes.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Adnp perturbation recurrently increased Cacnb3 in Pvalb GABA, MB Glut, and MB P MY GABA neurons.

literature_rationale: Target-specific Srebf2 deletion directly reduces the same signed cholesterol-biosynthesis and uptake program. Neuronal cell-group placement is descriptive and does not weaken that agreement.

Phf12 and Uba5 remain dataset-supported neighbors but lack a supplied specific bridge and are excluded from the literature-backed claim.

Shared transport or pathway context alone is insufficient, so adding Dync1h1 does not convert the comparator relationship into a literature-supported chain.
