finding_summary: The only FDR<0.10 hit in 191 MB P MY GABA was Man2c1 up-regulation.
finding_consequence: Man2c1 provides a second, anatomically separate single-gene catabolic readout, suggesting that any acute Zfhx4 response is sparse and context-specific.
cell_types: 191 MB P MY GABA

finding_summary: Zfhx3, the strongest Zfhx-family data-driven neighbor, did not phenocopy Zfhx4: Zfhx3 produced a 19-gene 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut signature and up-regulated Zfhx4, whereas Zfhx4 had no FDR<0.10 genes in that cell group and did not share Sccpdh or Man2c1 effects with Zfhx2 or Zfhx3.
finding_consequence: The result argues against simple postmitotic interchangeability across Zfhx-family transcription factors and points to directional Zfhx3-to-Zfhx4 regulation in a thalamic class.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut; 110 CNU-HYa HY MM Glut; 191 MB P MY GABA

finding_summary: The expected Phox2b/Atoh1 respiratory-center program was absent: Zfhx4 perturbation did not change Atoh1 or Phox2b at FDR<0.10, and direct Atoh1 or Phox2b perturbations were themselves FDR-null across the same 22 recovered groups.
finding_consequence: This separates the known neonatal brainstem survival mechanism from the juvenile postmitotic neuronal compartment actually read out by the screen.

finding_summary: Zfp961 produced one FDR-controlled responder: Dctn2 increased and Strn4 decreased in 012 MEA LA CA1 DG Glut, while 21 other measured neuronal groups had no downstream FDR<0.10 genes.
finding_consequence: The positive response is real but extremely sparse; it restricts interpretable Zfp961 biology in this screen to a MEA/LA/CA1/DG glutamatergic two-gene signature rather than a pan-neuronal KRAB-ZFP program.

finding_summary: The Zfp961 signature was isolated: the closest data-driven neighbors had very weak correlations and none reproduced the Dctn2/Strn4 pair in the responding 012 group.
finding_consequence: This rejects the idea that the two Zfp961 hits are a common low-cell-count artifact or a broad module shared by many perturbations; Dctn2 and Strn4 reached FDR<0.10 only for Zfp961 in the queried 012 comparator set.
cell_types: 012 MEA LA CA1 DG Glut

finding_summary: KRAB/chromatin comparators did not phenocopy Zfp961: Casz1 and Zfp644 were flat, whereas Setdb1 and Chd4 had larger signatures in other cell groups but no 012 Dctn2/Strn4 convergence.
finding_consequence: Zfp961 is annotated as a KRAB C2H2 protein, but the neuronal phenotype is not a generic readout of perturbing heterochromatin effectors; Zfp961 appears buffered or context-specific relative to pathway-level chromatin perturbations.

finding_summary: Zic1 perturbation produced a single reproducible transcriptional change: Slc29a1 was induced in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, while every other measured cell group had zero downstream genes at FDR<0.10.
finding_consequence: The responder is not the cerebellar or embryonic progenitor compartment emphasized by Zic1 genetics; it nominates a narrow thalamic nucleoside-transporter output of the acute postmitotic perturbation.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: The full-screen nearest-neighbor calculation found only very weak, noncanonical convergence to Zic1; Wdr26 was the top genic positive neighbor and Zic3 ranked ninth, but neither reproduced significant Slc29a1 in the matched responder group.
finding_consequence: The Zic1 signature is so small that global correlations are exploratory; the result warns against treating a rank-neighbor as a phenocopy when the shared FDR-significant response is absent.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: The screen did not recover the canonical Zic1 cerebellar-progenitor, forebrain-progenitor, or dorsal neural-tube programs in mature sampled neurons.
finding_consequence: ZIC1/ZIC4 Dandy-Walker and the mouse Zic1-null phenotypes are better modeled as embryonic or early-postnatal lineage-production and foliation defects than as an acute, cell-autonomous transcriptomic requirement in the postmitotic neurons sampled at P37-44.

finding_summary: Zic paralogs and GLI-family pathway comparators failed to phenocopy Zic1 in the 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut responder group.
finding_consequence: A family/pathway prior alone would have predicted Zic2, Zic3, Zic4, or GLI factors to be plausible Zic1 comparators, but the measured P16 neuronal screen separates the Slc29a1 response from that embryonic Zic/GLI module.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Zkscan16 perturbation induced the puberty-inhibitory imprinted gene Mkrn3 in 155 MB Glut.
finding_consequence: The Mkrn3 direction is biologically provocative because MKRN3 inhibits puberty onset and human ZNF483 damaging variants are linked to delayed age at menarche; the data nominate Mkrn3 induction as a puberty-axis biomarker to test after Zkscan16 loss.

Thus the observed RNA non-equivalence cannot be classified as agreement or disagreement with a documented transcriptomic expectation.

finding_summary: Sil1 perturbation failed to recruit the canonical HSPA5/BiP unfolded-protein-response program across the assayed neuronal surface, despite related ER perturbations demonstrating that this RNA program was detectable in the screen.

finding_summary: Sil1 had no robust whole-screen signature neighbor; its largest signed-score cosine was only 0.0427 and the strongest negative neighbor, Ranbp2, had broad L5 ET and cerebellar signatures with no Rsrp1 convergence.

finding_summary: In 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut, Slc24a5 perturbation induced a small glycerophospholipid-associated RNA program comprising FDR-supported Lpcat4 with coordinated nominal Mgll and Stard10 increases.

cell_types: 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut

finding_summary: Slf2 loss produced a singleton Ppp5c induction in 008 L2-3 IT ENT PPP RSP Glut and nowhere else at transcriptome-wide FDR<0.10.

finding_summary: Slf2’s whole-profile neighbors were essentially noise-level and did not reproduce the 008 Ppp5c hit.

finding_summary: The canonical replication-coupled SLF2–SMC5/6 DNA-repair program was not transcriptionally recovered after acute Slf2 loss in postmitotic neurons.

finding_summary: The screened SMC5/6 and ATR-pathway relatives Nsmce2 and Atr did not phenocopy Slf2 or induce Ppp5c.
finding_consequence: If Slf2 knockdown had engaged the canonical SMC5/6 recruitment or ATR replication-stress circuit, Nsmce2 or Atr perturbation might have converged in the same neurons; instead both were flat, reinforcing the conclusion that this basal assay is outside the pathway’s productive context.

finding_summary: The 155 MB Glut Srpk1 response is not reproduced by nearby BAF subunits.

finding_summary: Smarcc1 fails to enter the strong thalamic BAF module that is induced by Smarcb1, Smarcc2, Arid2, Arid1a, and Smarce1 perturbations.

finding_summary: Smo perturbation induced the Hedgehog-adjacent regulator Rnf220 in 155 MB Glut.
finding_consequence: RNF220 is a documented Shh/Gli regulator, making it the only near-threshold Smo gene with an obvious Hedgehog literature connection.

cell_types: 155 MB Glut

finding_summary: Smo loss produced a real but extremely sparse response in 155 MB Glut: one downstream gene, Rnf220, was induced at FDR<0.10, while the other 21 measured cell groups had zero robust downstream genes.
finding_consequence: This prevents the target from being miscalled as globally silent; the only recovered response is anatomically restricted and centers on an E3 ligase that later links back to Hedgehog biology.
cell_types: 155 MB Glut

finding_summary: The lone Smo-induced gene, Rnf220, is a Shh/Gli regulatory E3 ligase, so its up-regulation is an exploratory candidate feedback response rather than an unrelated marker.
finding_consequence: RNF220 can positively tune Shh target expression in cerebellar precursors and medulloblastoma and can also regulate GLI localization and autophagic handling; seeing Rnf220 rise after Smo loss nominates it as a readout or attempted compensation in the only neuronal class with a robust Smo hit.
cell_types: 155 MB Glut

finding_summary: Smo loss did not recover the canonical Hedgehog/GLI transcriptional program, and directly screened Hedgehog relatives did not phenocopy the MB Glut Rnf220 signal.
finding_consequence: A downstream GLI/PTCH/HHIP program was detectable in principle but absent, and Ptch1, Ptch2, Gli2, Gli3, and Gpr161 were themselves flat; the screen therefore refines the canonical SMO pathway to earlier or unsampled Hh-responsive cells rather than acute postmitotic NeuN+ neurons.
cell_types: 155 MB Glut

finding_summary: The data-driven Smo signature has no strong recurrent neighbor: top restricted all-screen neighbors were weak non-responders, and the 155 MB Glut anti-neighbor Sec31a produced a large signature with no Rnf220 overlap.
finding_consequence: The weak correlations argue that the singleton Rnf220 response is target- and cell-context restricted rather than part of a common stress, ER, or guide-load module across the screen.
cell_types: 155 MB Glut

finding_summary: Snrpb loss produced a singleton Foxp1 up-regulation in 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut nuclei.
finding_consequence: Foxp1 is the only gene surviving FDR correction after Snrpb perturbation anywhere in the screen, so it nominates a narrow cortical identity or compensation marker rather than a broad spliceosome-collapse program.

finding_summary: Snrpb was nearly silent while matched spliceosome perturbations Srsf1, Snrnp70, and Prpf6 were broad responders.
finding_consequence: The divergence argues that the Snrpb null surface is specific to this SmB/B' perturbation context, not proof that gene-level snRNA-seq cannot detect the consequences of splicing-factor loss in these neurons.

finding_summary: The brain Sm paralog Snrpn did not share the Snrpb Foxp1 signature and was itself almost completely flat.
finding_consequence: A literature-obvious paralog relationship did not translate into a common postnatal neuronal DE phenotype, further separating steady-state SmB/SmN family relationships from acute P16 CRISPR gene-level outcomes.
cell_types: 007 L2-3 IT CTX Glut

finding_summary: Nominal Vgf repression after Sos1 loss aligned directionally with Braf and Map2k1 loss and opposed Nf1 loss, identifying Vgf as a local readout of reduced RAS–RAF signaling tone.
finding_consequence: Vgf behaves like a local readout of decreased RAS/RAF tone even though the full Sos1 signature is weak, preserving a pathway-consistent effect that an FDR-only analysis would miss.
literature_rationale: The literature specifically anchors SOS1 upstream of RAS and VGF to neurotrophin signaling, but the cross-perturbation signs come from the experiment and do not by themselves complete the literature chain from SOS1 loss to Vgf repression.

finding_summary: In 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut, Sos1 did not recover the Vgf/Ptpn5/Etv5/Atp2a2 Ras/MAPK-output axis that moved up with Nf1 loss and down with Braf, Map2k1, or Shoc2 loss.
finding_consequence: The matched-cell comparison shows that the thalamic neurons were capable of transcribing a Ras/MAPK-output signature, so the Sos1 null is more consistent with upstream buffering than with a universal readout failure.
cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Sos2, the closest Sos1 paralog, was itself transcriptionally flat in 20 recovered matched groups and did not reproduce either the Sos1 Cul7 hit or the 151 Ras/MAPK-output module.
finding_consequence: The paralogs are homologous RasGEFs, but the screen provides no evidence that single Sos2 loss phenocopies single Sos1 loss in juvenile neurons.

finding_summary: The absence of a Ras-gain transcriptional program after Sos1 CRISPR LoF is directionally consistent with SOS1 RASopathy alleles being gain-of-function rather than simple loss-of-function.
finding_consequence: A flat LoF surface in this screen should not be used to argue that activated SOS1 variants or developmental SOS1 signaling are irrelevant to brain phenotypes.

finding_summary: Sox9 perturbation lowered Sec23a in 215 MB Dopa, consistent with the documented SOX9-to-CREB3L2/BBF2H7-to-Sec23a regulatory chain.
finding_consequence: Sec23a is a COPII/ER-to-Golgi trafficking gene that lies downstream of a SOX9-CREB3L2/BBF2H7 secretory program in chondrocytes, so its isolated decrease is a biologically coherent but low-confidence candidate readout rather than a generic neuronal stress signature.
literature_rationale: A singleton can be primary when a complete target-specific chain predicts the observed direction. Promotion is limited to the Sec23a readout: it does not establish activation of a broader secretory program or dopaminergic selectivity, and confidence is moderated by borderline FDR, low perturbed-cell count, null intermediate-axis transcripts, and transfer from chondrocytes.
cell_types: 215 MB Dopa

finding_summary: Neither data-driven neighbors nor literature-obvious SOX, NFI, Notch, Hedgehog, and FGF/STAT comparators converged on the Sox9 surface in the matched Sox9 groups.
finding_consequence: The expected paralog/cofactor neighborhood does not form a shared acute neuronal module; the strongest global Sox9 similarities were near zero and matched-cell data rejected the nearest local neighbors as phenocopies.

finding_summary: Acute Srgap3 loss produced a single corrected downstream transcript, Stxbp1 down-regulation, in 027 NP-CT-L6b-OB Glut.

finding_summary: Data-driven neighbours of Srgap3 were nearly orthogonal and were rejected in the 027 validation slice.

cell_types: 027 NP-CT-L6b-OB Glut

finding_summary: The only Srgap3 responder did not express a corrected Slit-Robo/Rac/WAVE transcriptional module.
finding_consequence: Loss of a GAP can alter RAC1 or CDC42 activity without moving the mRNAs encoding receptors, GTPases or actin regulators; their FDR=1.0 values argue that the dataset captured a narrow Stxbp1-low nuclear state, not a broad feedback program onto the canonical actin pathway.
cell_types: 027 NP-CT-L6b-OB Glut

finding_summary: Perturbing measurable Slit-Robo and Rac-actin pathway neighbours did not phenocopy Srgap3 in its responder group.
finding_consequence: Robo1, Robo2, Slit2, Rac1, Cdc42, Pak1, Pak2, Pak3 and Limk1 were direct screen targets, yet each had zero corrected downstream genes in 027 and failed to regulate Stxbp1, separating the acute Srgap3 output from simple receptor, GTPase or kinase knockdown signatures.
cell_types: 027 NP-CT-L6b-OB Glut

finding_summary: The screen shifts SRGAP3 loss away from an acute pan-neuronal nuclear program and toward structural, developmental and ventricular-lineage biology.
finding_consequence: Human SRGAP3 disruption and germline mouse Srgap3 loss have neurodevelopmental consequences, but a P16 mosaic NeuN+ perturbation generated exactly one corrected mRNA in 1675 perturbed neuronal cells; this positions the disease-relevant biology mostly before the assay window, outside NeuN+ lineages, or in cytoskeletal/spine phenotypes not encoded by a large nuclear response.

finding_summary: The only FDR-supported Stag1 downstream signal was Gabra1 down-regulation in 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut.
finding_consequence: Gabra1 points to a narrow inhibitory-receptor/synaptic readout rather than a genome-wide cohesin-collapse program, but it is a one-gene, hypothesis-generating signature.

finding_summary: The data-driven Stag1 signature neighborhood was effectively empty.
finding_consequence: The nearest positive and negative neighbors had absolute cosine values below 0.035; return-to-data checks showed that broad responders such as Tpr and Wdr26 did not define a shared Stag1 module, so the Stag1 surface should be interpreted as weak rather than forced into a convergent module.

finding_summary: Stag1 did not phenocopy the cohesin/loop-regulator perturbations that were active in the same 151 thalamic class.

cell_types: 151 TH Prkcd Grin2c Glut

finding_summary: Stard7 produced a single significant downstream event: Pcmtd1 was down in 191 MB P MY GABA and no other cell group had any FDR<0.10 downstream gene.
